name: Potentiostat 1
label: Potentiostat
tooltip: High-performance potentiostat for EIS, CV and chronoamperometry. Frequency range up to 7 MHz.
overview: The Biologic SP-200 is a high-performance research-grade potentiostat/galvanostat with built-in EIS capabilities. It is one of the most widely used instruments in electrochemical research worldwide.
specs: CV, CA, CP, EIS, GEIS, PEIS, OCV
usage: Suitable for corrosion studies, battery characterisation, electrocatalysis, and impedance spectroscopy. Training required before first use.

name: Potentiostat 2
label: Potentiostat
tooltip: Modular potentiostat with built-in impedance analyser. Ideal for battery and fuel cell characterisation.
overview: The Metrohm Vionic is a modular potentiostat with an integrated impedance analyser. Its compact design and high accuracy make it well-suited for fuel cell and battery testing.
usage: Ideal for electrocatalysis screening and rotating disk electrode experiments. Can be combined with RDE 1.

name: Potentiostat 3
label: Potentiostat
tooltip: Flexible multichannel system for simultaneous electrochemical measurements on several cells.
overview: The Origalys OrigaFlex is a flexible multichannel electrochemical system allowing simultaneous measurements on several cells. Particularly useful for parallel screening experiments.
usage: Best suited for parallel catalyst screening and multi-cell battery testing. Comes paired with RDE 2.

name: RDE 1
label: RDE
tooltip: Rotating disk electrode for hydrodynamic voltammetry. Speed range 100–10 000 rpm.
overview: A rotating disk electrode (RDE) system used for hydrodynamic voltammetry. The controlled rotation speed allows mass transport to the electrode to be precisely tuned, enabling accurate kinetic measurements.
usage: Used for oxygen reduction reaction (ORR), hydrogen evolution, and electrocatalyst benchmarking. Koutecky-Levich analysis possible.

name: RDE 2
label: RDE
tooltip: Rotating disk electrode coupled to the OrigaFlex potentiostat. Supports RRDE configuration.
overview: The Origalys RDE system supports both RDE and RRDE (rotating ring-disk electrode) configurations. It is directly coupled to the OrigaFlex potentiostat for seamless multichannel operation.
usage: Supports RRDE experiments for product detection (e.g. H₂O₂ during ORR). Training required for RRDE configuration.

name: AFM
label: Microscopy
tooltip: Atomic Force Microscope for surface topography at sub-nanometre resolution. Contact and tapping modes available.
overview: The Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) provides topographic imaging of surfaces at sub-nanometre resolution without requiring a vacuum environment. It is essential for characterising electrode surfaces before and after electrochemical experiments.
usage: Used for surface roughness analysis, thin film characterisation, and operando electrochemical AFM studies. Booking mandatory — training session required.

name: DEMS
label: Spectroscopy
tooltip: Differential Electrochemical Mass Spectrometer for real-time detection of gaseous products during electrochemical reactions.
overview: The DEMS (Differential Electrochemical Mass Spectrometer) enables real-time, online detection of volatile and gaseous products formed during electrochemical reactions. It is a powerful tool for mechanistic studies.
usage: Key instrument for CO₂ reduction product analysis, hydrogen evolution monitoring, and oxygen evolution studies. Requires prior discussion with platform manager.

name: Polishing Machine
label: Preparation
tooltip: Mechanical polishing station for electrode surface preparation. Currently under maintenance.
overview: The polishing machine is used to prepare electrode surfaces before electrochemical experiments. A clean, well-polished electrode is critical for reproducible results.
usage: Standard protocol: polish with 1 µm then 0.3 µm then 0.05 µm alumina, rinse with ultrapure water, sonicate 5 min.
